**Street Photography**

![qq.jpg](https://res.cloudinary.com/hpiynhbhq/image/upload/v1518101449/enjbqxfdtrbighsipvg9.jpg)

Street Photography / street photo is one kind of photo documentary featuring its subject from candid situation in public place like street, park, beach or other place. According to Thomas Leuthard, "street photography is simply the documentation of public life in an honest way". Street photography uses a technique of (straight photography or pure photography #) in which it shows a pure vision or purpose of something like a reflection of the condition of society. Street Photography is also one of the streams in photography that in the taking of the image more the object.

![qqq.jpg](https://res.cloudinary.com/hpiynhbhq/image/upload/v1518101511/gv0p4pvpruibzraphjz4.jpg)

Street photography is more likely to be ironic and to be limited or distant from the subject matter itself, and often subject to a single human situation, concerning the provisions of the sharpness situation.

Photographs in street photography can take locations from various public spaces such as streets, markets, malls, terminals, etc. Photographs taken are generally using straight photography techniques, where the photo describes what conditions For street photography techniques (street photography) is more concerned with the meaning of the photo itself and does not require a special technique to create street photography.![q.jpg](https://res.cloudinary.com/hpiynhbhq/image/upload/v1518101547/kxx9chsurlldokffgmep.jpg)

But still try to make photography beautiful with time. I did some photography myself. I hope you like my photography. ![IMG_368620.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSfSjVDtUF7c4PZ3CVP6oXGkSiBrkCbg5a66BRUx2Civr/IMG_368620.JPG) ![IMG_31168620.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbsT6ikyrwE29LiJJnsZdkAQtQvpXCfHZ2y5HbR6tQepV/IMG_31168620.JPG) ![IMG_316168620.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRn8UFREyp73Qvacr2Taq2DtfPcNE9v6M1HDKkMjwe9aq/IMG_316168620.JPG) Wildflower photography. I like wild flowers very much. This wildflower is very small in size. However, these flowers are seen a lot on the side of the road and on the side of the ground. But we call these wild flowers as nose flowers. A few days ago I photographed this wildflower from the front of our house. So today I have shared the photography of this wild flower with you very beautifully. This is photography of a falling leaf. We call these leaves curry leaves. When these leaves fall, the color of the leaves changes. The fresh leaves fall from small to large in this way. Photographing this page reminded me of my own life. One day in our life this will leave the body. I took a very nice photo of this page and shared it with you today. ![IMG_321168620.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNhFjvGTWzGsrYAQq5iUYwtZLsiq5rMjHGYthknwfV8rm/IMG_321168620.JPG) ![IMG_331168620.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmah3txoNf7jeygGWmoy2e7kjsCjGVF2JQgdU7TP21ocPa/IMG_331168620.JPG) ![IMG_341168620.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcWCHjd1HCwVqhM63x5zmbJzMZhhjww2JuwQtxuTwNFjQ/IMG_341168620.JPG) This is beautiful rose flower photography. Rose is my favorite flower. Everyone loves roses. There are many varieties of roses. Rose is also called the queen of flowers. Actually rose flower is a symbol of love. A few days ago I photographed this rose flower from a nursery garden while traveling. So today I have shared this beautiful photography of rose flowers with you. This is great photography. Street photography is a flow in photography. Street photography generally contains objects taken in public open spaces in candid or no direction conditions. There is no agreement on the exact equivalent of street photography in Indonesian, but the term street photography is often used on several occasions. Photographs in street photography can take locations from various public spaces such as roads, markets, malls, terminals, railway stations, and so on.
![jjj.jpg](https://res.cloudinary.com/hpiynhbhq/image/upload/v1520176330/e9b1mkbexwfdhn7t9ryl.jpg)

Street photography including the oldest style has started in Malaysia by Lambert and some photographers in the Dutch colonial era in Indonesia. The term is more precisely adjacent to journalistic photography. Although the beginning of its development there is a flow of surrealism like Bill Brandt, Henri Cartier Bresson. Although Bresson's style changed after entering Magnum into a style that is more easily understood and can enter the category of everyday life on the road. The odd alloy between the photographed subjects is that there is a mannequin or an angel statue in the garden or where it should not be the mannequin or the angel statue. So when the photo looks odd alloy and often called surrealism. The influence of surrealism is great on street photographs.
![jjjj.jpg](https://res.cloudinary.com/hpiynhbhq/image/upload/v1520176350/liuvcepd2cqmin4jyk6j.jpg)

Photographers who photographed on the street will not all look surreal, even there are photographers who do not experiment on the street for many years and the photos do not reflect journalism or to be posted in magazines or newspapers. Harry Callahan photographed the streets and was influenced by Balthus painters, he experimented with photographing gaps between floors, windows, photographing the streets at night, photographing pedestrian cropping, and many other experiments. So it is with photographer Jeff Wall who set up 3 models to act as racism in the street. 
![jjjjj.jpg](https://res.cloudinary.com/hpiynhbhq/image/upload/v1520176418/ceiri4eubmkepgbnlscp.jpg)

Photographs taken on the flow of photography generally use the technique [: en: Straight photography straight photography]. Photos describe the condition as it is by minimizing object manipulation. In its development, street photography incorporates elements such as surrealism, humor, and surprise in its composition. To get those elements in a photo, it is necessary to look for the most precise moment with unique object positions.
